indicator_name: Unit labour cost, productivity, real wage, enterprise profits to GDP, quarterly (computed by this repository)
description: Удельные издержки на труд, производительность, реальная заработная плата, прибыль предприятий к ВВП, поквартально (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: ULC = average monthly wage (AVG_WAGE_1T_QUARTERLY, enterprises' survey, from 2015) over real output per employed person (QNA_GDP_EXPENDITURE_SA_CONSTANT_2010 / EMPLOYED_BY_SECTION_QUARTERLY TOTAL). The wage is not seasonally adjusted (Q4 bonuses), so read the y/y rates; the indices are 2015 = 100. Real wage: deflated by the CPI level (chained CPI m/m, quarter mean). WAGE_BILL_PROXY_TO_GDP applies the enterprises' wage to all employed persons, self-employed included -- an upper bound, not the national-accounts compensation of employees (INCOME_COMPENSATION_BY_SECTION). PROFIT_BALANCE_TO_GDP: ENTERPRISE_PROFIT_LOSS_QUARTERLY profit + loss (large and medium enterprises, before tax) over the quarter's nominal GDP.
